hook: THE FIRST NBA GAME WAS IN CANADA
yt_title: Where Was The First NBA Game? Not In The US #Shorts
desc: The first game of the league that became the NBA was played in Toronto, Canada, on November 1, 1946. It was first called the Basketball Association of America. New fizzy fact every day on Fruit Soda.
caption: Did you think the NBA began in America? 🏀 Follow for a fact every day. Comment YES or NO

lines.text: Where was the first NBA game played? Not in America.
It was Toronto, Canada, on November first, nineteen forty-six.
The New York Knicks beat the Toronto Huskies that night.
The league was named the Basketball Association of America.
In nineteen forty-nine it merged and became the NBA. Which team do you think lasted?
